candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student (m/f/d) Partner Success – Data & Reporting
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Partner Success – Data & Reporting. Defining KPIs with business teams, working out where data comes from and how reliable it is, and turning it into clear reports is exactly what I did in my previous roles.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with four SAP Certified Associate certifications. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I translated business requirements into KPI-based reporting and documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built
I investigated sources and dependencies and rebuilt datasets end to end during a 42-dashboard migration to SAP Datasphere
I used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to make sure reported numbers were correct

letter.problems_section: I would help define partner KPIs, build a common data model for OEM and utility partnerships, consolidate CRM and platform data and set up regular partner reports. My Power BI is basic, but I have built many dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and would get up to speed quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
